 Product Description
 
 

 
 
 

 

 

 
 
 Looking for a pendant that feels stylish, meaningful, and powerful at the same time? The Peru Pyrite Pendant with Chain is made for you. It brings together the natural beauty of Peru Pyrite, the charm of fashion jewellery, and the positive energy associated with abundance and prosperity.

Sourced from Peru, a place known for its rich mineral beauty and natural crystals, this Pyrite carries a raw, earthy, and premium appeal. Its golden-silver metallic texture makes every pendant look unique, bold, and naturally attractive.

According to crystal healing beliefs, Pyrite Crystal is mainly known as a money magnet. It is commonly associated with attracting wealth, fame, success, confidence, and prosperity. It is also believed to support strength, positivity, and protection from negative energies.

This pendant comes with an 18K gold tone plated chain, so you can wear it directly without worrying about finding a matching one separately. The elegant golden chain and raw Peru Pyrite centerpiece together make it a fashionable crystal accessory with both style and purpose.

Each piece is handcrafted with care, and every crystal passes through an authenticity check before it reaches you, ensuring a genuine and meaningful crystal accessory crafted by India’s biggest energy brand.

Kindly note that images are just a graphical representation of crystals. Size, shape, texture, and colour may vary at the time of delivery.

Disclaimer: Crystals are believed to support positive energy, confidence, and intention, but they work best when combined with your own efforts, right actions, and consistent hard work. Results may vary from person to person.

 FAQ
 
 

 
 
 

 

 

 
 
 Q1. What is included in this product?

This product includes a Peru Pyrite Crystal Pendant along with an 18K gold tone plated chain.

Q2. What is Peru Pyrite Crystal known for?

Peru Pyrite Crystal is commonly associated with wealth, abundance, success, confidence, prosperity, and protection.

Q3. Is the chain included with the pendant?

Yes, the pendant comes with an 18K gold tone plated chain, making it ready to wear.

Q4. Can I wear this pendant daily?

Yes, you can wear it daily as a fashionable crystal jewellery accessory, but avoid contact with water, perfume, sweat, and chemicals.

Q5. Is this pendant handcrafted?

Yes, this is a handcrafted crystal jewellery piece, which gives every pendant a unique natural look.

Q6. Will every Pyrite Crystal look the same?

No, every natural crystal is unique, so size, shape, texture, and colour may slightly vary.
